description.default: One-click privacy mode: hide names in the file tree, tabs, doc title and window title. Supports custom aliases per notebook/document, a shared placeholder, a top bar button and a keyboard shortcut.
description.zh_CN: 一键隐私模式：遮盖文档树、顶部页签、文档大标题与窗口标题中的名称。支持按笔记本/文档单独设置别名与开关，统一占位内容，顶栏按钮或快捷键切换。
